spec.name: NWS forecast bias against the settlement high
spec.description: If official NWS point forecasts of the daytime maximum are biased relative to the settlement-authority daily high at a station, a bias-corrected forecast could price threshold contracts differently from the market. NWS CLI reports issued after each day provide a point-in-time reference for estimating that bias.
spec.hypothesis: If official NWS point forecasts of the daytime maximum are biased relative to the settlement-authority daily high at a station, a bias-corrected forecast could price threshold contracts differently from the market. NWS CLI reports issued after each day provide a point-in-time reference for estimating that bias.

features.name: nws_pfm_max_f
features.description: NWS Point Forecast Matrix daytime (7am-7pm local) maximum for the target local date, from the latest product issued at or before the decision time. A forecast of the daytime maximum, not the calendar-day settlement high.

features.name: nws_cli_bias_f
features.description: Mean of (NWS CLI reported high - PFM daytime maximum issued at the same relative decision time) over earlier target dates whose CLI final report had been issued by the decision time. CLI is a reference observation, not the settlement source.

invalidation_conditions: Bias-corrected probabilities do not beat the market-implied Brier score on the validation partition.
The estimated bias changes sign between partitions.
Fewer independent station-days than the minimum for the selected depth.
assumptions: Fixed predeclared one-contract YES/NO candidate, not a tuned execution policy.
Only verified decision-time sized books and certified fee versions support replay.
Replay fills are simulated; no real-money execution is authorized.
